# Refuge — Coffee · Bar · Bistro

> Independent bistro and bar in the heart of Douglas, Isle of Man, run by
> husband-and-wife team Rob and Tamara. Seasonal, locally sourced Manx produce,
> signature cocktails and the island's famous espresso martini.

## Key facts

- Address: 52 Athol Street, Douglas, IM1 1JB, Isle of Man
- Phone: +44 1624 616584
- Email: hello@refuge.co.im
- Opening hours: Mon closed · Tue–Wed 12:00–16:00 · Thu–Fri 12:00–23:00 ·
  Sat 17:30–23:00 · Sun closed
- Booking: https://dazzler.app/isle-of-man/douglas/refuge-d99r/book-a-table
- Cuisine: Modern European / Bistro; dietary labels (V, Ve, Gf) marked on menus
- Private hire available for celebrations, corporate functions and occasions
- Reviews: Tripadvisor, Google and Facebook listings linked from the site
